title: The apps
subtitle: Five ways to make history talk
description: Each app trains a different skill: asking questions, moderating, arguing, stepping into someone else's shoes.

youModerate.name: You moderate
youModerate.description: Two characters debate a topic you choose. You run the debate: give the floor, ask questions, keep them on topic.

personaggioMisterioso.name: Mystery character
personaggioMisterioso.description: A character hides who they are. You get a few questions to find out, then you make your guess.

doppiaIntervista.name: Double interview
doppiaIntervista.description: Ask two characters the same questions and compare their answers, like a TV double interview.

convinciTu.name: Convince them
convinciTu.description: Pick an idea and try to win over a historical character. They only change their mind if your arguments hold up.

impersonaTu.name: Play the part
impersonaTu.description: Play a historical character while the AI plays another. It asks you questions to see how well you know your role.
